_comment: Single source of truth for the MaxP apex public routes (SEO). Consumed by src/seo/publicRouteSeo.ts (client) and scripts/prerender-public-routes.mjs (build-time static shells + sitemap.xml). Add a route here once — nothing else to keep in sync.
_notes: prerender=false keeps the route out of the static shells (only the root, whose tags the built index.html already carries).
sitemap.include=false keeps the URL out of sitemap.xml (aliases, auth pages, ad-only landings).
noindex=true emits <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"> in the static shell (ad landings use noindex, nofollow client-side).
Ad-only landings are deliberately NOT in robots.txt Disallow: a disallowed URL can never be crawled, so its noindex tag would be unreadable.
